metadata.title: Opti Assist
metadata.description: AI assistant for factory floors — fast, grounded answers from your machines, manuals, and data.

forgotPassword.heading: Reset your password
forgotPassword.body: Enter your account email. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent a reset link.
forgotPassword.sentHint: Check your inbox — and your spam folder, just in case. The link is valid for a limited time.

resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.doneBody: Your password has been updated. You can now log in with the new password.
resetPassword.linkInvalidHint: The link may have expired or already been used.
resetPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters.

consent.heading: Before you continue
consent.subtitle: OptiAssist is provided to your employer under a master agreement with Optipeople. Please confirm you've read the two short documents below.
consent.termsLabel: I have read and accept the end-user terms of use.
consent.privacyLabel: I have read the privacy notice and understand how my data is processed.
consent.analyticsLabel: I agree to anonymous product analytics (optional).
consent.analyticsDescription: Helps Optipeople improve the product. You can change this at any time. Has no effect on what's logged for audit purposes.
consent.requiredHint: * Required. Optipeople records your acceptance against your email for audit purposes.

qrBanner.title: By using OptiAssist on this machine
qrBanner.body: You agree to the <terms>end-user terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>. Your factory has already signed the master agreement with Optipeople.

accountSelect.heading: Choose account
accountSelect.subtitle: You have access to several accounts. Choose the one you want to work in.
accountSelect.empty: No machines have been added to Opti Assist yet. Email {email} for help getting started.

newAccountWizard.step1Description: The account is created in Optipeople together with its first administrator, who receives an invitation email.
newAccountWizard.accountCreatedButUnresolved: The account was created in Optipeople, but its id could not be resolved, so the remaining steps can't run here. Finish the setup in the Optipeople portal.
newAccountWizard.step2Description: Machines always belong to a factory. You can skip this and add it in the Optipeople portal later.
newAccountWizard.timeZoneEmpty: No time zones found for this country
newAccountWizard.step3Description: Adds the machine to Opti Assist so its knowledge base and chat work right away. It can be linked to an Optipeople machine later.
newAccountWizard.step4Description: Optionally add another user to the account. The administrator from step 1 has already been invited.
newAccountWizard.doneDescription: {account} is ready. You can now select it from the account list.

machineSelect.heading: Choose machine
machineSelect.subtitleForAccount: Machines in {account}. Choose the one you are working at.
machineSelect.subtitleNoAccount: Choose the machine you are working at.
machineSelect.empty: No machines have been added to Opti Assist for this account. Email {email} for help getting the machines added.
machineSelect.emptyAdmin: No machines have been added to Opti Assist for this account yet. Add the first one under {link}.

qrError.heading: The QR code doesn't work
qrError.askAdmin: Ask a super-admin to generate a new QR code for the machine.
qrError.invalid: The QR code is invalid or has been deactivated.

chat.emptyPrompt: Ask about installation, maintenance, tool changes, alarms, or anything from your machine's manual.
chat.disclaimerBody: Always check the manual or ask a colleague before doing anything on the machine.
chat.endedPlaceholder: Chat ended. Start a new one above.

fallbackQuestions.q2: Which documents do you have access to?
fallbackQuestions.q3: Where do I find the manual?

attachments.tooMany: You can attach up to {max} images per message.
attachments.unsupported: Unsupported file. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP under 10 MB.

viewer.cannotPreview: This file type can't be previewed.

knowledgeDrawer.heading: Documents
knowledgeDrawer.description: Manuals and documents for this machine. Click any item to open it.
knowledgeDrawer.empty: No documents available yet. Ask your administrator to make manuals visible here.
knowledgeDrawer.adminEmptyBody: Add manuals or images for this machine in the admin. They'll appear here and the assistant will use them to answer operator questions.

feedback.promptHint: Help the next operator by telling us whether the answer solved your problem.
feedback.thanksResolved: Marked as resolved. This helps the next operator with the same issue.
feedback.thanksUnresolved: Marked as unresolved. We'll look into it.
feedback.solutionLabel: What worked? (optional — will be shared with the next operator)
feedback.solutionPlaceholder: E.g. The RESET button + restart the controller after reading the alarm code.

voice.heading: Voice conversation
voice.sayPrompt: Say what you need help with.

escalationPage.expiredBody: The service request is more than 30 days old and is no longer available. Contact the operator for a new request.

gate.notLoggedInBody: Log in to access the admin area.
gate.unauthorizedBody: The admin area is reserved for administrators. Your role: {role}.

machinesList.heading: Machines
machinesList.emptyFirst: Press "Add machine" to add your first machine.
machinesList.openChatTitle: Open chat in a new tab

machineDetail.machineNameTooltip: Fetched from the Optipeople platform (the name the machine is registered with there).
machineDetail.accountNameTooltip: Fetched from the Optipeople platform (the name the account is registered with there).
machineDetail.conversationsTitle: See all conversations for this machine
machineDetail.escalationsTitle: See all service calls for this machine
machineDetail.testChatTitle: Open the operator chat for this machine in a new tab
machineDetail.deleteMachineTitle: Delete the knowledge base for this machine
machineDetail.deleteConfirmBody: The knowledge base, all documents, folders and embeddings are removed permanently. Conversations and audit history are kept. This action cannot be undone.
machineDetail.qrDescription: The operator scans the sticker on the machine and lands directly in the chat — without logging in.
machineDetail.qrRegenConfirmBody: The existing code becomes invalid immediately. Operators scanning old stickers will get an error until they get a new print.
machineDetail.qrRevokeConfirmBody: Operators can no longer scan in to the machine. You can always generate a new one later.
machineDetail.uploadDescription: Drag any files or a whole folder here — PDFs, images (PNG/JPG/WebP) or other formats. The folder structure is preserved. Images are described with Claude vision; text files are indexed for chat; other files are stored as downloadable attachments.
machineDetail.folderLabel: Folder (only for files picked via the button below)
machineDetail.dropPrefix: Drag PDFs, images or a folder here, or
machineDetail.bulkDeleteConfirmBody: The documents and all their embeddings are removed permanently. This action cannot be undone.
machineDetail.bulkDeleteFailed: {failed} of {total} documents could not be deleted
machineDetail.autoOrganizeTitle: Let Claude suggest a folder structure for your documents
machineDetail.emptyTree: No manuals yet. Upload the first one above — or create an empty folder and fill it later.
machineDetail.rootDrop: Root (drag here to move to root)
machineDetail.deleteFolderConfirmBody: The folder is empty. It is removed from the structure.
machineDetail.reprocessConfirmBody: Existing chunks are deleted and the document is processed again via vision. It can take a minute and consumes Claude tokens. Previous answers in conversations are not affected, but new searches will use the new content.
machineDetail.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the pop-up. Allow pop-ups or use the download button.
machineDetail.deleteDocConfirmBody: The document and all its embeddings are removed permanently. This action cannot be undone.
machineDetail.feedbackTitle: Auto-promoted from operator feedback (marked as working)
machineDetail.reprocessTitle: Run through Claude OCR again — runs in the shared queue
machineDetail.deleteFeedbackTitle: Demote — remove the operator experience from KB
machineDetail.colOperatorVisibleTitle: Visible to operators in the chat-side knowledge drawer
machineDetail.operatorVisibleShowTitle: Hidden from operators — click to make visible
machineDetail.operatorVisibleHideTitle: Visible to operators — click to hide
machineDetail.bulkVisibilityFailed: Could not update visibility for {failed} of {total} documents

machineEscalation.heading: Service escalation
machineEscalation.description: When the operator presses «Call service», a message is sent to this contact with a temporary link to the conversation.
machineEscalation.sharedAcrossPrefix: The setting is shared across all machines under
machineEscalation.notConfiguredHint: Operators see the button but get a hint asking admin to configure the contact first.
machineEscalation.removeConfirmBody: Operators can no longer use the 'Call service' button until a new target is configured. Existing escalations are not affected.

conversations.heading: Conversations
conversations.description: Audit of all operator chats for this machine. Click a row to see the full flow and which manuals the AI consulted.
conversations.empty: No conversations yet for this machine.

conversationDetail.fetchFailed: The conversation could not be loaded
conversationDetail.heading: Conversation from {date}
conversationDetail.operatorMarkedResolved: Operator marked the conversation as resolved
conversationDetail.operatorMarkedUnresolved: Operator marked the conversation as unresolved
conversationDetail.toolCallsOnly: (only tool calls — see tool message below)

escalations.heading: Escalations
escalations.description: Audit of all service calls for this machine. Click a row to see the full conversation, or open the technician link to see the same as the recipient.
escalations.empty: No escalations yet for this machine.

addMachine.heading: Add machine
addMachine.description: First pick an account, then a machine. We create an empty knowledge base that you can fill with manuals afterwards.
addMachine.displayNamePlaceholder: Used in admin and chat headings

autoOrganize.heading: Auto-organize documents
autoOrganize.description: Claude suggests a folder per document. Uncheck what you don't want to move.
autoOrganize.allInPlace: All documents are already in a good folder — or Claude isn't sure where they belong.

qrPrint.noActive: There is no active QR code for this machine.
qrPrint.scanInstruction: Scan the code with the camera on your phone and ask your question directly to Opti Assist for this machine.
qrPrint.pngHint: The PNG is 1200×1500 px — suitable for printing on an A6 label or pasting into Word documents before printing.

server.aiUnavailable: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
server.aiRateLimited: Too many requests right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
server.aiError: The AI ran into a problem. Please try again.

escalation.noTarget: Service escalation is not configured for this account. Ask an admin to set it up.
escalation.emailIntro: An operator has requested service via Opti Assist.
escalation.emailLinkIntro: Read the full conversation here (valid until {expires}):

twilio.notConfigured: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID / TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is not configured — admin must set them in Vercel env
twilio.fromNotConfigured: TWILIO_FROM is not configured — set a sender number or Messaging Service SID

admin.machineAlreadyExists: The machine has already been created
admin.invalidPhone: Phone number must be in E.164 format (e.g. +4512345678)
admin.invalidWebhookUrl: Webhook target must be a valid http(s):// URL

escalate.notePlaceholder: E.g. Machine alarms 731 and won't start after restart.

escalate.doneEmail: Email sent to {target} with a link to the conversation.
